title: Vente Venezuela portals reportedly exposed personal and biometric data, VE Sin Filtro says
date_note: El Estímulo says a threat actor disclosed the flaws on a public Telegram channel on November 21; the page gives no earlier day for the exposure.
geo_basis: country; the article names no city
summary: El Estímulo reports that the NGO VE Sin Filtro confirmed two security flaws in the Constructores and Monitoreo Ciudadano portals of Vente Venezuela, allowing data to be extracted without authentication. According to VE Sin Filtro the exposed data includes names, ID numbers, contact details and facial recognition templates stored in plain text. The article says platform managers applied security measures on November 22.
plain: An NGO says two Vente Venezuela portals exposed people's personal data and face templates without a login. Managers reportedly applied security measures on November 22.
exec: According to VE Sin Filtro, a Venezuelan political platform exposed ID and biometric data; El Estímulo says no public report from Vente Venezuela had been issued.

validation.note: Only El Estímulo was read; VE Sin Filtro's report and Vente Venezuela's own statement were not read.
